newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair - new data system to boost profits.
newsitem.headline: Finnair - new data system to boost profits.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said on Wednesday it would acquire a new data system monitoring sales from Unisys and that it expected the system to boost profitability by tens of millions of markka.
"Finnair will acquire a new system to monitor sales, which is expected to boost the group's profitability by tens of millions of markka per year," Finnair said in a statement.

It said the airline revenue enhancement system (ARE) would cost 10 million markka including programmes and equipment, and the first phase of the system would be in use in the autumn. The system would be in full use next year.
"The ARE-system forecasts demand for seats based on statistics and optimises sales and profits in real-time," Finnair said.
